Screw Conveyor
VECTOMEC™ Conveying Range
The screw conveyor — known in ancient times as the Archimedes' screw — remains one of the most versatile and cost-effective bulk material handling devices in modern industry. Jayveecons designs and fabricates screw conveyors for horizontal, inclined, and vertical orientations, engineered to your material's specific bulk density, particle size, abrasiveness, and moisture content. Our sealed trough designs are particularly effective in dusty environments such as cement and mineral processing.

Bucket Elevator — Belt Type
VECTOMEC™ Conveying Range
Belt-type bucket elevators are used extensively in cement, grain, and fertiliser industries to elevate bulk materials vertically with minimal material degradation. The continuous belt carries spaced buckets that scoop material at the boot, elevate it, and discharge centrifugally or gravimetrically at the head. Jayveecons designs and fabricates complete elevator assemblies including casing, head and boot sections, belting, buckets, drive and tensioning arrangements.

Bucket width100mm – 600mm

Vertical Shaft Kiln (VSK)
VECTOMEC™ Processing Range · Founding Technology
The Vertical Shaft Kiln is the technology that founded Jayveecons in 1987 — and it remains our deepest area of expertise. Unlike a rotary kiln where material is tumbled through a rotating drum, a VSK is a stationary vertical shaft: raw meal is nodulised (formed into balls by a disc pelletiser), mixed with solid fuel (coal), and charged from the top of the shaft. As the nodules descend under gravity through progressively hotter zones, calcination occurs and clinker forms. Finished clinker is discharged at the bottom.

The VSK's key advantages over rotary kilns are significantly lower capital cost, simpler civil works, lower power consumption, and the ability to be profitable at capacities of 50–300 TPD — making it the preferred choice for mini cement plants and lime producers where a large rotary kiln would be uneconomical.
Typical Specifications
Capacity range50 – 300 TPD clinker (standard); custom larger
Shaft diameter2.0m – 4.5m internal
Shaft height8m – 20m effective calcination zone
Feed requirementNodulised raw meal (requires nodulizer — supplied separately)
FuelCoal (mixed with raw meal nodules), wood, biomass
Shell materialFabricated MS shell with refractory lining
Clinker dischargeRotating grate or reciprocating pusher at base
Applications
Mini cement plants (50–300 TPD) Quicklime production Dolomite calcination Calcium carbide Replacement VSK shells VSK upgrades & refurbishment
Scope of Supply

Our Founding Expertise
Jayveecons was established in 1987 specifically to serve small-scale cement plants using VSK technology. Over nearly four decades, we have accumulated more VSK design and operational experience than almost any other engineering firm in India. If you are evaluating a mini cement plant, expanding an existing VSK operation, or need to refurbish an ageing shaft, our team should be your first call.

Rotary Kiln Components
VECTOMEC™ Processing Range
A rotary kiln is an inclined, slowly rotating refractory-lined cylinder that thermally processes bulk material as it travels from the elevated feed end to the lower discharge end. Rotary kilns are used in large-scale cement production, lime manufacture, mineral roasting, and waste incineration — typically at capacities of 200 TPD and above, where their higher capital cost is justified by throughput.

Jayveecons fabricates key structural and mechanical components for rotary kiln installations and refurbishment projects: shell sections, riding rings, support and thrust rollers, girth gears, and kiln seals. We work with plant operators and EPC contractors as a fabrication partner for both new-build and replacement components.
Components Supplied
Shell sectionsRolled & welded MS plate, various diameters
Riding rings (tyres)Cast or fabricated alloy steel
Support rollersCast steel, with shaft and bearing housing
Thrust rollersTo control axial movement of rotating shell
Girth gear & pinionCast or fabricated, to customer specification
Inlet / outlet sealsLeaf seal and labyrinth seal configurations
Typical Applications
Cement clinker production Quicklime & dolomite Iron ore pelletising Mineral roasting Sponge iron (DRI) Replacement / refurbishment

Ball Mill / Grinding Mill
VECTOMEC™ Processing Range
Ball mills are the standard in cement and mineral grinding. A cylindrical mill shell lined with wear-resistant liners rotates on trunnion bearings, tumbling steel or ceramic grinding media against the feed material to produce fine powder. Jayveecons designs both overflow and grate-discharge configurations, with open-circuit and closed-circuit arrangements depending on the required product fineness.
Design Parameters
Shell diameter0.9m – 4.0m
Shell length1.5m – 14m
Grinding mediaSteel balls, cylpebs, ceramic
LinersManganese steel, rubber, chrome-moly
Applications
Cement grindingRaw meal grinding Coal grindingMineral grinding CeramicsChemical powders
